todos: SESSION HANDOFF (2026-10-05, main): All eight audit fixes are implemented. Six findings are closed; AUDIT-03 and AUDIT-04 still require controlled-machine Windows Update download/install validation. Interactive UI validation and the long-idle white-window observation remain pending. Verified commands: run.ps1 Setup, Format -NoRestore, Lint, Typecheck/Test -Configuration Release -NoRestore (265/265 tests), package.ps1 -NoRestore -Fast, and test-installer-owned-files.ps1; all used -NonInteractive where supported. Real WinGet CLI search and native WUA search cancellation smoke also passed. Generated setup/portable artifacts are in artifacts/dist/OnlyWinget/Release and are ignored by Git.

P3 - BLOCKED - AUDIT SCRATCH CLEANUP (2026-10-05): Automatic approval review rejected removal with 'blocked by policy', including bounded nonrecursive cleanup. Own ignored directories remain: artifacts/audit-probe-20261005, artifacts/bin/AuditProbe, artifacts/obj/AuditProbe. No production data is stored there. Do not repeat blocked deletion attempts without a change in authorization or execution policy.

P1 - DONE - AUDIT-01 (2026-10-05): Installer extraction and removal use the same generated file list; recursive installation-directory deletion removed. NSIS setup/portable packaging and isolated ownership regression pass; unrelated root/nested files are preserved. Regression included in check.ps1.

P1 - DONE - AUDIT-02 (2026-10-05): SQLite load/migration failures propagate and block saves until a successful reload. Startup preserves the load diagnostic. Damaged-row and malformed-legacy regressions confirm data preservation.

P1 - IMPLEMENTED / LIVE VALIDATION PENDING - AUDIT-03 (2026-10-05): Windows Update uses Begin/End jobs with RequestAbort and CleanUp; cancellation never triggers fallback and installation failures never retry automatically. Unit regressions and a real native search cancellation smoke pass. Download/install cancellation still requires validation on a controlled machine with available updates.

P1 - IMPLEMENTED / LIVE VALIDATION PENDING - AUDIT-04 (2026-10-05): Both installation paths require exact update ID/revision matches and complete selection coverage; downloads must succeed before installation. Application rejects missing, duplicate, or wrong-revision results. Regression tests pass; actual installation/revision-change scenarios remain to be validated on a controlled machine.

P2 - DONE - AUDIT-05 (2026-10-05): Removed the invalid WinGet COM adapter; composition uses the supported CLI search/resolver with source-specific caching. Source/cancellation regressions and live PowerToys search against the winget source pass.
P2 - DONE - AUDIT-06 (2026-10-05): Only reliably comparable numeric versions can skip an upgrade. Unknown/nonnumeric versions are delegated to WinGet; unknown and prerelease regressions pass.

P2 - DONE - AUDIT-07 (2026-10-05): Scans retain installation results/restart warnings; the ViewModel rescans only after successful installation. State/restart regression passes; interactive UI validation was not performed.

P2 - DONE - AUDIT-08 (2026-10-05): Bulk paste validates the full batch before replacing the preset; mixed-validity input leaves the original preset unchanged. Regression passes. Final suite: 265/265 tests; format, lint (24 scripts), locked restore, and warnings-as-errors build pass.

BASSO - APERTO (non chiudibile da un agente): Verificare in produzione se la mitigazione 'schermata bianca dopo inattivita'' in MainWindow.xaml.cs (RefreshAfterLongIdle, toggle SystemBackdrop + InvalidateMeasure/Arrange dopo 5+ minuti di inattivita') risolve effettivamente il sintomo - root cause mai confermata, nessun repro disponibile. Richiede osservazione reale su una macchina utente nel tempo, non verificabile in una sessione di sviluppo. AppDiagnostics.Write in RefreshAfterLongIdle registra gia' il trigger della mitigazione (con durata idle) nei log/Log Viewer dell'app per raccogliere evidenza in futuro.
